- Add an internal reviewer step (Legal) between Redwood first signatory and CEO so Marissa can route to legal for a final sign-off checkbox.
- Ensure the MSA and Order Form are mutually dependent in the envelope (Order Form cannot complete until MSA is signed).

Once Ben confirms the tweak, Marissa can upload final documents to DocuSign and I will do a pre-flight.
